title: The Respect My Rights Modpack
description: Companies and governments continue to insist that our rights as humans don't matter. Mojang has recently followed this trend thanks to the UK government's """Online Safety Act""" This modpack includes mods that give you your rights (and performance) back.
body:
Companies and governments continue to insist that our rights as humans don't matter. Mojang has recently followed this trend thanks to the UK government's """Online Safety Act""" This modpack includes mods that give you your rights (and performance) back.

The mods included aim to remove the _questionably legal_ telemetry data collection that is normally _collected against your consent with no ability to meaningfully opt-out_, allows you to _express yourself freely_, and generally _increases the performance_ of your game.

I am a long time fan of Minecraft, but the direction Mojang has taken things in recent years has long bothered me and others in the community. Hopefully this pack can act as a convenience for others that are bothered by the decisions from Mojang and co. Thanks to all the mod developers whose mods are included in this pack, please support them and not myself; they are the real heros here and their efforts are meaningful. I am just a casual player who is tired of the world devolving into 1984.
